classification.difficultyReason: The instruction supplies factorisation; students retain each factor branch and apply familiar exact ratios and quadrant selection.

content.prompt: Solve for $\theta\in[0^{\circ},360^{\circ})$. Remember, to solve quadratic equations we need to factorise.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2\cos^2\theta-\cos\theta&=0\\\cos\theta(2\cos\theta-1)&=0\\\cos\theta&=0\quad\text{or}\quad\cos\theta=\frac12.\end{align*}$$
For $\cos\theta=0$, $\theta=90^{\circ},270^{\circ}$.
For $\cos\theta=\frac12$, $A=\cos^{-1}(\frac12)=60^{\circ}$. Cosine is positive in Q1 and Q4, so $\theta=60^{\circ},300^{\circ}$.
Hence $\theta=60^{\circ},90^{\circ},270^{\circ},300^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{align*}\tan^2\theta-\tan\theta&=0\\\tan\theta(\tan\theta-1)&=0\\\tan\theta&=0\quad\text{or}\quad\tan\theta=1.\end{align*}$$
For $\tan\theta=0$, $\theta=0^{\circ},180^{\circ}$.
For $\tan\theta=1$, $A=\tan^{-1}(1)=45^{\circ}$. Tangent is positive in Q1 and Q3, so $\theta=45^{\circ},225^{\circ}$.
Hence $\theta=0^{\circ},45^{\circ},180^{\circ},225^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{align*}2\cos^2\theta-1&=0\\(\sqrt2\cos\theta-1)(\sqrt2\cos\theta+1)&=0\\\cos\theta&=\frac1{\sqrt2}\quad\text{or}\quad\cos\theta=-\frac1{\sqrt2}.\end{align*}$$
$A=\cos^{-1}(\frac1{\sqrt2})=45^{\circ}$. The positive and negative ratios give solutions in all four quadrants.
$\theta=45^{\circ},135^{\circ},225^{\circ},315^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{align*}3\tan^2\theta-1&=0\\(\sqrt3\tan\theta-1)(\sqrt3\tan\theta+1)&=0\\\tan\theta&=\frac1{\sqrt3}\quad\text{or}\quad\tan\theta=-\frac1{\sqrt3}.\end{align*}$$
$A=\tan^{-1}(\frac1{\sqrt3})=30^{\circ}$. The positive and negative ratios give solutions in all four quadrants.
$\theta=30^{\circ},150^{\circ},210^{\circ},330^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{align*}2\sin\theta-1&=0\quad\text{or}\quad\sin\theta+1=0\\\sin\theta&=\frac12\quad\text{or}\quad\sin\theta=-1.\end{align*}$$
For $\sin\theta=\frac12$, $A=\sin^{-1}(\frac12)=30^{\circ}$. Sine is positive in Q1 and Q2, so $\theta=30^{\circ},150^{\circ}$.
For $\sin\theta=-1$, $\theta=270^{\circ}$.
Hence $\theta=30^{\circ},150^{\circ},270^{\circ}$.
